scientific_integrity: Analytic results proved for equal-duration two-patch switching with shared quadratic density limitation; independently generated numerical checks are supportive rather than decisive proof. Scientific originality is qualified by incompletely accessible related literature.
scientific_limitations: No stochastic interpretation or field validation; unequal seasons, generalized crowding and arbitrary switching unaddressed.
title: One sharp seasonal switching threshold and a universal critical extinction profile in two-patch cross-recruitment
